gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was $3,985.091m. During 2015 there was a small prior-year favourable run-off (release) of $8.4m in aggregate, primarily due to reductions in ultimate loss estimates (favourable claims development). The releases were concentrated in Aviation ($7.2m), Marine ($5.4m) and Liability/Casualty ($10.7m) but were more than offset by increases in reinsurance-related reserves ($20.2m), yielding a net prior year release. The movement is explicitly stated in the movement note.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure (-8.4) is taken from Note 10 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (explicitly stated). Amounts throughout the accounts are presented in US Dollars (thousands) and have been converted to millions (USD) for this output. There is a material RITC note (2013 and prior years reinsured to close into the 2014 year of account for an RITC premium of $2,043m) noted in the strategic report which can distort claims development triangles and year-on-year comparatives; users should treat triangular analyses with caution. The report's narrative and movement note figures were used rather than net narrative figures; where LOB labels differ between notes the regulatory segmental names were used verbatim for premium mix.
